slots.name: Matt 'Beryl' Hodges
slots.role: Track design & Ramps. Events, Website and Bookings. Ugger dugger work.
slots.bio: Matt raced back in 88-95 the olden days. Came back in 2022 and is a certifield mad for it racer. Matt likes to race everywhere, from regionals to Euros, Matt will have a crack at it, always aiming to have fun. Probably talks too much.

slots.name: Paul 'Bruce' Curtis
slots.role: Wales' 'Handomest' Race Director. Track setup. Race Control. Heavy lifting. Public facing
slots.bio: Some say he can clear a room, all we know is he is called Bruce

slots.name: Mike 'Mike' Driscoll
slots.role: Track setup. Ramps and heavy lifting. Treasury work. L&L Support. Likes a bit of Nitro.
slots.bio:
Mike raced back in 86 - 91. Came came back to racing in 2021 and hasn’t looked back. 
Spends his summers outdoors sniffing the nitro running 1/8th scale buggy and constantly checking his weather app!
Travelled all round the UK racing in NitroX Cross, RCGP and Neo Land, and has also featured on The Gridtalk RC podcast when the host was short on options.

slots.name: Steve 'Steve' Curtis-Rich
slots.role: Track setup. Carpet preparation. Stage work. Race control setup.
slots.bio: Steve was introduced to the hobby in 1988 by Bobtech, competed 2wd as 4wd was too expensive at club, regional and national level in Stock 2wd and retired in 1997. Like any other boy band, made a come back in 2004 with TC. Since then have done 12th, GT12, 8th Nitro & buggy but mainly 10th off-road. Been a Schumacher fan boy for way to long!

slots.name: Bob 'Bobtech' Gelstharp
slots.role: Track setup. Velcro guru. Carpet preparation. Stage work and general setup work.
